title: Applying an Earned Pals Rewards Tier — Desk Rule and Booking Tool
content:
## Desk rule

Under **Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus**, when the qualifying spend of a free-tier membership has earned the next free tier above the one it holds, a care agent applies that earned tier effective the day it is applied and posts the earned-tier upgrade bonus with it.

The earned-tier upgrade bonus is not posted until the rewards ledger carries a points earning for the most recent charged Autoship shipment.

Put the other way round: while the rewards ledger shows no points earning for the most recent charged Autoship shipment, the earned-tier upgrade bonus is not posted.

| Tier held | Next free tier above it |
|---|---|
| Pals Rewards Member | Pals Rewards Insider |
| Pals Rewards Insider | Pals Rewards VIP |

Pals Rewards VIP has no free tier above it, and the Tailwise Plus tiers are bought, never earned by spend.

## Booking tool: `apply_earned_tier_ebf561a6`

**Capability.** Applies a free Pals Rewards tier that the customer has earned by spend and posts the bonus that comes with it. One call moves the membership to the stated tier effective today, records the change as an upgrade earned by spend, books one tier-upgrade bonus entry on the rewards ledger dated today, and adds the bonus to the points balance. The customer then sees the new tier on the account and the bonus in the points history.

**How it is invoked.** An agent-side tool: the care agent unlocks it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and calls it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`.

**Parameters**

- `membership_id` — the reference number of the customer's Pals Rewards membership, read from the membership lookup for this customer (identifier).
- `new_tier` — the tier the membership moves to, one of: Pals Rewards Member (the entry tier every member holds without qualifying spend, never an upgrade target); Pals Rewards Insider (the free tier earned by the Insider qualifying spend); Pals Rewards VIP (the free tier earned by the VIP qualifying spend); Tailwise Plus Monthly, Tailwise Plus Annual and Tailwise Plus Premier Annual (paid tiers that are bought, never earned by spend, and so not targets of this action).
- `upgrade_bonus_points` — the tier-upgrade bonus to post, a whole non-negative integer of points.

**Return.** On success: status `tier_applied`, the `membership_id`, `variant_name` (the tier now held), `tier_effective_on` (today, YYYY-MM-DD), `member_event_id` (the bonus entry's reference number), `upgrade_bonus_points` posted and `points_balance` after the bonus.
